record.paper_title: Some open problems in mutual stationarity involving inner model theory: a commentary.
record.context_brief: Consistency strength of a mixed cofinality stationarity pattern on [ℵ_ω]^{ω_1} determined by a set A⊆ω.
record.original_question: For A⊆ω, define S_A to be the set of all X∈[ℵ_ω]^{ω_1} such that for every integer m>1, the cofinality of sup(X∩ω_m) is ω when m∈A and is ω_1 when m∉A. Assume that A contains infinitely many successor pairs n,n+1 and also omits infinitely many successor pairs n,n+1. What is the exact consistency strength of the assertion that S_A is stationary?

evidence.quote:
Question 3 What is the consistency strength of “For some A⊆ω which in-
ﬁnitely often both contains and omits successor pairs n, n + 1 of integers, SA is
stationary.”?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Work in ZFC. For an infinite cardinal κ and a cardinal λ<κ, let [κ]^λ denote the set of subsets of κ of cardinality λ. A set S⊆[κ]^λ is called stationary if for every function F:[κ]^{<ω}→κ there exists X∈S with |X|=λ that is closed under F.

For a set A⊆ω, define
   S_A = { X ∈ [ℵ_ω]^{ω_1} : for every integer m>1, cf(sup(X∩ω_m)) = ω if m∈A, and cf(sup(X∩ω_m)) = ω_1 if m∉A }.

Assume that A⊆ω is such that there exist infinitely many integers n with {n,n+1}⊆A and also infinitely many integers n with {n,n+1}∩A=∅ (i.e., A infinitely often contains and infinitely often omits successor pairs n,n+1).

Determine the exact consistency strength, in terms of large cardinal hypotheses, of the statement: "There exists such a set A⊆ω for which S_A is stationary in [ℵ_ω]^{ω_1}."
artifact.category_tag: mutual stationarity and inner model theory
artifact.status_search_result: Recent works (Adolf–Cox–Welch 2022 on lower consistency bounds; Adkisson–Sinapova on mutual stationarity and combinatorics at ℵ_ω; Ben-Neria on singular stationarity) establish upper and lower bounds for related mutual-stationarity assertions at ℵ_ω with mixed cofinalities, but no source identifies an exact consistency strength for the mixed-cofinality pattern with both successor pairs in A and successor pairs missing from A. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Lower consistency bounds for mutual stationarity with divergent cofinalities and limited covering
status_evidence.snippet: Improves previous lower bounds for mutual stationarity allowing infinitely many sets of countable cofinality, but does not pin down exact strength for the mixed pattern over ℵ_ω.
status_evidence.claim: Provides partial lower bounds, not an exact consistency strength.

status_evidence.title: Mutual stationarity and combinatorics at ℵ_ω (Adkisson–Sinapova)
status_evidence.snippet: Consistency of mutual stationarity for sequences of cofinalities ω^k from large cardinals.
status_evidence.claim: Upper bounds from large cardinals exist but exact strength of the mixed-successor-pair pattern is not determined.

status_evidence.title: On singular stationarity I (mutual stationarity and ideal-based methods)
status_evidence.snippet: Studies mutual stationarity using ideal-based methods.
status_evidence.claim: Related results, but exact strength of S_A stationarity for the specified A remains unresolved.
